def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    answer = [1] * n
    left = 1
    for i in range(n):
        answer[i] = left
        left *= nums[i]
    right = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        answer[i] *= right
        right *= nums[i]
    return answer

def rotate(nums, k):
    k = k % len(nums)
    nums.reverse()
    nums[:k] = reversed(nums[:k])
    nums[k:] = reversed(nums[k:])
